notes: Summary: Nimbus builds an IDE copilot for enterprise dev teams (focus: repo-aware completions, cross-repo search, and PR summarization). Looking for a provider that supports low-latency streaming, model pinning per workspace, and strict data residency.

Key requirements: streaming tail latency <100ms per token for local edits; concurrent support for ~300 active devs during peak; embedding-backed retrieval with per-repo access control; ability to pin model versions per customer workspace.

Repo ingestion: prefer incremental mirror (git clone + webhook) into a vector pipeline. Chunking strategy requested: code-aware chunking (function/class boundaries), preserve repo provenance metadata per chunk (file path, commit hash).

Embeddings: they prefer open/quantized models for cost control but want Redwood's recommendation on embedding model that balances recall for code snippets vs cost. Will test both 1536-d vs 1024-d vectors.
Vector DB & residency: must be able to host vectors in their VPC (or on-prem) in EU/US regions; evaluating Qdrant + protected replicas. Concerned about index rebuild time and snapshot restore SLAs.
Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, enterprise KMS integration, full audit logs for prompts/queries, retention controls (90/365 day policies), per-workspace RBAC.
POC success metrics: 1) retrieval recall @ top-5 >= 85% on curated test set, 2) median token latency for streaming <60ms, 3) cost per 1k completions within target range provided by Nimbus finance.
Quotes: 'We need vector locality — code must stay inside our VPC or EU datacenter for certain customers.' — Head of Platform (Elena Park).
Integration notes: wants model/version pinning API so customers can opt into newly verified model releases; needs stable inference artifacts for A/B testing inside the copilot product.
Open questions from security: what telemetry is sent to Redwood's control plane (stack traces, logs, metrics)? Do you provide an air-gapped on-prem bundle for Tier-1 customers?

Internal sales notes: focus the next demo on streaming trace (tail latency) and an embedding recall test using a 10k-file repo snapshot. Prepare a cost extrapolation for 300 devs at 6 months of usage. SE to propose quantization profile and vector replication options.
